selected_benchmarks.description: Paper-level CPU comparison target from Table 1, evaluated in this reproduction on a small subset extracted from the paper's released benchmark archive. Size ratio is the paper's average size ratio target; reproduced scores use the median common-task size ratio against the local reference baseline.
selected_benchmarks.notes: The reference values for Bolt and Scarlet are the full-suite paper numbers. Reproduced scores are computed on the tracked 10-instance subset, so solve_rate is directly comparable as a fraction but not as a full-suite solved count.

solve_rate.description: Fraction of slice instances for which the returned formula independently separates positive from negative traces.

evaluation_coverage.description: Fraction of slice instances for which the method emitted an output row, preventing omission of hard cases from improving rates.

formula_size_ratio.description: Median returned-formula size ratio against the local reference baseline on instances both methods solve.

all_returned_formulas_valid.description: Whether every non-empty returned formula is syntactically parseable and semantically valid on its traces.

mean_collapse_ratio.description: Optional diagnostic ratio emitted by methods that report candidate-reduction metadata. It is not used for ranking.

solve_rate_delta_vs_baseline.description: Solve-rate improvement over the local reference baseline on the same slice.

baseline_miss_solve_rate.description: Fraction of reference-baseline-unsolved slice instances that the method solves.
